bio.text: Greg Abbott is the Governor of Texas, first elected in 2014 and re-elected in 2022, and is the Republican nominee for governor in the November 2026 election, according to Texas Public Radio.
Before becoming governor he served as Texas Attorney General, as a Justice on the Supreme Court of Texas and as a state district judge in Harris County.
Abbott was born in Wichita Falls, was raised in Duncanville, and graduated from the University of Texas at Austin and earned a law degree from Vanderbilt University.
